 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Maryland football is set to play its first game under interim head coach Aazaar Abdul-Rahim on Halloween against a resurgent Illinois team. The game is set to kick at 12 p.m. Saturday in College Park and will air on FS1.
 For your pregame entertainment, Testudo Times previewed the matchup against Illinois , and the trio of football reporters hopped on a podcast with Drew Pastorek of Oskee Talk to offer their predictions for the game as well.
